message: Non-jsonl files under .claude/review/learnings/feedback/ are neither reviewed nor gated, while CODEOWNERS still owns them.

The hand-picked .claude patterns do not cover everything CODEOWNERS owns under /.claude/, so new .claude files (for example .claude/statusline.sh or .claude/review/metrics/**) can be bot-approved. The comment saying every .claude path is covered is not true.

CODEOWNERS header still says "This file is the one list", and CLAUDE.md line 196 still says "add or remove paths there, not here". Both now conflict with the new mirrored list and the "change both together" rule.
The edited paragraph still says CODEOWNERS is the one list and to change paths only there, then says to change both. It also says human_approval mirrors CODEOWNERS, which is not exactly true.
The new header comment is a single ~115 char line, while the surrounding comments wrap near 90 chars across lines.
The PR template still asks that the bot has approved, which can never happen on a one-way-door PR now. The next line does ask for a person on one-way doors, so the impact is small.
